name: JetBrains AI Pro

price.note: Included with All Products Pack and dotUltimate licenses.

check.label: JetBrains AI widget, or JetBrains Account

meters.label: Monthly AI credits
meters.hint: 10 credits ($10). The JetBrains AI widget in the IDE header shows credits left.

reset.rule: Resets every 30 days from the date you first used your JetBrains AI license, not on your billing date.
stipulations: 1 AI credit is $1. Cloud models spend credits at their token cost.
Code completion, next edit suggestions and local models (Ollama, LM Studio) don't spend credits.
Junie and the built-in Claude Agent spend these credits.
Top-up credits are used only after the monthly credits run out.

overage: At the limit, cloud AI features stop until the 30-day reset. You can buy top-up credits at $1 each in JetBrains Account or the AI widget. They last 12 months and are never bought automatically on individual plans.

how: 10 AI credits ($10) every 30 days, spent at each cloud model's token cost.
Code completion and local models are unlimited.
ext: Claude, GPT and Gemini models are available in AI Assistant and Junie, and spend credits.
Bring your own Anthropic, OpenAI or OpenAI-compatible key. That usage bills to your key, not your credits.
ACP agents such as Codex use their own provider login, not JetBrains credits.
quirks: JetBrains' licensing page also shows AI Pro at $20 for 20 credits and AI Ultimate at $60 for 70. That looks like the organization price; the page doesn't label it.
Not available in China since 13 July 2026.
Codex can wrongly deduct JetBrains credits after a ChatGPT login (third-party report, unconfirmed).
AI Pro comes with All Products Pack and dotUltimate, but not with free student or open-source licenses.
